building: Delta Gamma, Beta Iota Chapter, Purdue University

sources.provider: Purdue GIS BuildingShapesZip4 ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0
sources.source_crs: WKID 102100 / latestWkid 3857, Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere; query requested outSR=3857
sources.limitations: NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO conflict with an official 2026 state budget committee description of the existing house as two stories and a basement. Extrution units and floorplan path semantics are undocumented; the GIS polygon is not a survey.

sources.provider: Delta Gamma at Purdue, official Beta Iota chapter house page
sources.evidence: Search-indexed page identifies the house at 303 Waldron Street and says residents use the front porch. The chapter page could not be fetched directly by the web reader; no photograph was copied. This supports identity and porch use, not dimensions or current facade details.

sources.provider: Indiana State Budget Committee, April 2026 meeting minutes
sources.evidence: The committee description of the existing 303 Waldron Street Delta Gamma property states nearly 18,000 gross square feet, two stories, and a basement. It discusses a purchase/leaseback while a new facility is constructed. This establishes a more recent building scale/story source than the contradictory GIS count, but does not supply a measured elevation or footprint plan.

sources.provider: Delta Gamma Fraternity, Collegiate Chapter Histories (Beta Iota history)
sources.evidence: The search-indexed official history reports that the chapter broke ground in May 1958 on a Georgian U-shaped house with a courtyard and moved in February 1959. A direct retrieval attempt returned 404 on this date, so the text is retained as indexed evidence only. It supports the broad historical plan/style, not a measured current elevation.

A first-person February 2018 post describes a front porch, crowded multi-person bedrooms, a communal top-floor 'cold air' bunk room, and common areas including a lounge. The post is dated and anecdotal; it provides qualitative layout/use context, not a current measured plan. Linked photographs were not copied.

sources.provider: OpenStreetMap Overpass snapshot retained at repository root
sources.evidence: The way is tagged building=university without a name; its four-node rectangular outline provides a secondary location/extent cross-check only.

sources.provider: Purdue University Fraternity, Sorority and Cooperative Life
sources.evidence: Lists Delta Gamma among Panhellenic chapters and links the Purdue Beta Iota site; it supports chapter identity only.

coordinate_transform: Inverse Web Mercator (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857) to longitude/latitude, then repository-local approximation X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040.0. This is approximate campus-local meters, not a surveyed CRS.
height_story_interpretation: Use the official April 2026 description (two stories plus basement) as stronger current count evidence than the GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 field, while preserving the conflict. All modeled story heights, overall heights, roof geometry, fenestration, facade details, and interior partitions remain estimates unless directly dimensioned.
image_rights: No remote photos or illustrations are copied into this source packet; URLs, dates, and observations are retained instead.
